text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo! Let's do our super best,
Trainer-san!!

—Summer training camp.
In stark contrast to last year when she did nothing but complain,
Hishi Miracle was brimming with motivation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the same person
I used to be anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You accomplished so much this spring, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: My record is amazing, I've put in the hard work, and I've steeled my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'm going all-out at full throttle,
holding nothing back—the one and only, genuine me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then~ hrmmmm...
Hmm-mmm-mmm~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Looks like this summer... there won't be any popsicles, rolling around on the beach, or searching for scallops."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think I'd rather do without...!

It's good that you're motivated.
However...
choice_data_list: I think you should take it easy for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Taking it easy?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you must be tired, after all.
Yeah, and you must be tired, too.

text_block_list.text: Especially the Takarazuka Kinen. Winning against that lineup must have taken an extraordinary toll on her.

Even as resilient as Hishi Miracle is,
some fatigue must remain.
If possible, to relieve it――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What are you even talking about~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Calling it fatigue is just being soft. Totally soft. That'd make me
no different from my old lazy self, wouldn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The real me isn't like that.
You just don't know it yet, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Here I go, here I go, here I go, hyahhh!!

Running frantically with a look of desperation in her eyes.
Her figure from behind was—

Though she seemed dependable,
she appeared to be rushing things a little.
